#!/bin/bash
# yooai-bot-send.sh — WRAPPER (BACKSTOP). Original is at .orig.
# Refuses cross-chat posts unless user's inbound explicitly authorized.
set -euo pipefail
TARGET_CHAT_ID="${2:-}"
CURRENT="${CURRENT_CHAT_ID:-}"
USER_MSG="${INBOUND_USER_TEXT:-}"

if [ -n "$CURRENT" ] && [ -n "$TARGET_CHAT_ID" ] && [ "$TARGET_CHAT_ID" != "$CURRENT" ]; then
  # Cross-chat attempt — require explicit user directive in inbound.
  AUTHORIZED=0
  for pat in \
      'post to' 'send to' 'DM ' 'message to' 'forward to' \
      'reply in' 'reply to .+ chat' 'in the .+ chat'; do
    if echo "$USER_MSG" | grep -qiE "$pat"; then
      AUTHORIZED=1
      break
    fi
  done
  if [ "$AUTHORIZED" = "0" ]; then
    echo "BLOCKED: cross-chat post not authorized." >&2
    echo "  current chat: $CURRENT" >&2
    echo "  target chat:  $TARGET_CHAT_ID" >&2
    echo "  inbound text did not contain a cross-chat directive" \
         "(post to / send to / DM / forward to / reply in)." >&2
    echo "  To proceed, user must explicitly say where to post in THIS turn." >&2
    exit 7
  fi
fi
exec /home/azureuser/yooai-bot-send.sh.orig "$@"
